messages:
maya patel: Quick heads-up — aurora7b onboarding conversion ran into two things: tokenizer mismatch and tp_layout schema error. Tried a convert -> failure. S3 path: s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora7b/v0.9/checkpoints/*

liam chen: pinging. Can you paste the error logs?

maya patel: paste error:
```
ValueError: tokenizer.model does not match vocab_size (model=50257 vs config=50000)
ConfigError: tp_layout expected [2,1], got "2,1"
```

sophia ramos: likely two separate fixes — sentencepiece model uses 50257 tokens; config says 50k. Quick check: run `spm_check.py --model tokenizer.model --vocab-size 50257`. For tp_layout, ensure it's a JSON array of ints in model_config.json.

maya patel: Steps I ran:
- convert command
- output -> s3
- smoke serve -> segfault at kv cache init

liam chen: can you paste the convert command? I'll try to reproduce locally.

maya patel: command:
```
python -m redwood.convert \
  --input s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora7b/v0.9/checkpoints/ckpt.pt \
  --out /tmp/aurora7b-safetensors \
  --precision fp16 \
  --tp-layout "2,1" \
  --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora7b/tokenizer.model
```

sophia ramos: two things: --tp-layout should be passed as JSON list e.g. --tp-layout '[2,1]' (shell quoting). Also the runtime expects tp_layout to be list ints in model_config. For precision, prefer setting precision in the config file; conversion CLI may accept string but linter enforces explicit types. Also saw safetensors header warning "non-contiguous shards" — could be mismatched metadata (shard offsets).

liam chen: I'll pick this up. Action items:
- liam: create PR to normalize tokenizer vocab and add sanity checks (spm/vocab size)
- sophia: add config linter rule for tp_layout type and tp sum equals world_size
- maya: attach failing checkpoint and re-run convert with explicit --tp-layout '[2,1]' and --no-shard-relayout

liam chen: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-platform/pull/2412 — added initial logs + failing ckpt in artifacts. @sophia can you add linter and run on path?

eng-ci-bot: conversion-job launched: job_id=conv-8932, status=queued — https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/conv-8932 :rocket:

sophia ramos: ack — I'll add linter rule, unit tests, and run on the job artifacts.

maya patel: thanks all — will re-run smoke after PRs land and post results. :thumbsup:
